chunks: Do they say: 'He has forged it?' Say: 'Then bring ten Surahs like it, forged, and call anyone you can besides Allah, if you are truthful.'
ai.seo_question: What is the challenge of inimitability (I'jaz) presented in Surah Hud regarding the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This verse, known as the 'Tahaddi of Ten Surahs,' escalates the Qur'anic challenge of inimitability (I'jaz) from a single chapter to ten, emphasizing the depth and complexity of the text's linguistic and spiritual authority. In Shia exegesis, this is often viewed as a definitive proof of the Prophet's truthfulness, countering the Quraysh's assertion of fabrication by inviting them to summon their own allies or deities to assist in producing a comparable work. The mention of 'calling upon whom you can besides Allah' underscores the monotheistic core of the message, contrasting divine power with human or idolatrous limitations.
